# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Cronin Naughton Auctioneers are delighted to present 23 Monastery Terrace, Blarney Road to the market. It is a spacious four-bedroom semi-detached home ideally located in the popular Monastery Terrace development on Blarney Road. The property offers well-proportioned accommodation, generous outdoor space and excellent connectivity to Cork City and surrounding employment hubs.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Energetická náročnost: C2
- Lokalita: 23 Monastery Terrace, Blarney Road, Cork City
